$comment: Prestige-owned open-slot source. Prestige publishes two booking windows per open day — 9:00 AM and 2:30 PM Eastern (240-minute appointments) — and availability varies, so the calendar on /book is the only place that says what is actually open. The site never books through Google — finishing that form holds the slot before payment — so these windows are what /book and /api/open-slots serve. Edit this file, or set the PRESTIGE_AVAILABILITY env var to a JSON object with the same shape, when Emery opens or closes hours. Times are local wall-clock in `timeZone`, 24-hour HH:MM, and each entry is the START of one appointment window.
$confirmedWindows: 2026-09-29 (Derek): publish 9:00 AM and 2:30 PM Eastern. Availability varies — there is no per-day cap or sequencing rule on the public page, the calendar just shows what is open. Add weekday starts to `weekly` when Emery opens them.
